title: Fixed the "Read only" item of the context menu and the column menu unlocking a read-only column summary cell. The item no longer appears when the selection is only summary cells, and toggling a wider selection, such as a whole column, leaves a summary cell read-only, including after undo. Calling `setCellMeta()` or `removeCellMeta()` to make a read-only summary cell editable has no effect either; set the column summary's `readOnly` option to `false` instead.
